actual_checks: All exact scientific inputs and report read; no prior contributions listed. Literature scope is every contact form with torsion first Chern class on a closed connected non-lens 3-manifold, including degenerate forms; it makes no unrestricted non-torsion/degenerate assertion.

The two-or-infinity theorem has no nondegeneracy hypothesis. Its exactly-two classification forces a lens space; combining them gives infinitely many geometrically distinct primitive orbits on the stated non-lens scope. Iterates are not recounted as simple orbits.

For a rational homology sphere, UCT and rational Poincare duality give rank H^2(Y;Z)=0; finite generation makes it finite, so c1 is automatically torsion. Positive-b1 manifolds are covered only when their particular contact structure has torsion c1. Perturbation alone is not used to pass orbit infinitude to a degenerate limit.

scope_and_distinctness.exact_scope: For every closed connected non-lens 3-manifold, every contact form whose contact structure has torsion c₁ has infinitely many simple Reeb orbits, with no nondegeneracy assumption. In particular this covers all non-lens rational homology spheres. Forms with non-torsion c₁ are not included.
